# Coastline Rail: Riverton to Lakeport Timetable

Coastline Rail connects Riverton Central with Lakeport Union Station on a scenic route along the lake shore. Our express trains are popular with business travellers who want to use their journey time productively rather than spending it in airport queues.

## Express service

Express trains stop only at two intermediate stations and offer a quiet coach, power sockets at every seat and complimentary wireless internet. A cafe car serves hot drinks, sandwiches and snacks throughout the journey.

FACT: Coastline Rail express takes 3 hours 15 minutes from Riverton to Lakeport.
FACT: Coastline Rail fare is 89 dollars one way in standard class.
FACT: Coastline Rail runs 6 express departures each weekday.

## Stations

Riverton Central is in the heart of the city, within walking distance of most offices. Lakeport Union Station sits next to the financial district, so many travellers can walk directly to their meetings without needing a taxi.

## Tickets

Standard class tickets can be bought online, through the app or at station ticket machines. Advance tickets are cheaper but tied to a specific train. Flexible tickets can be used on any train on the day of travel. Business class adds a larger seat, a meal and access to the station lounge.

## Business accounts

Organisations can open a business account to manage bookings for multiple employees, receive monthly invoices and access discounted carnets of ten journeys. Carnets remain valid for six months from purchase.

## Reliability

Coastline Rail publishes punctuality figures each month. Delays of more than thirty minutes qualify for partial compensation, which can be claimed online within twenty eight days.
